jobs_results.title: Backend Developer Java
jobs_results.description:
ALOVIA es una firma con sede central en Madrid, España. Nos especializamos en la consultoría de RR.HH., basada en la provisión de las mejores soluciones de software del mercado.

Transformamos culturas, reconocemos talento, y unimos personas y organizaciones impactando en su desarrollo profesional.

Estamos a la búsqueda de un Backend Developer Java para importante cliente del sector textil.

Buscamos a alguien que esté acostumbrado a trabajar con enfoque en la calidad y buscando la eficiencia en los algoritmos desarrollados.

Con experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones backend que impliquen transferencias de grandes flujos de datos utilizando tecnologías como:
• Manejo de Jenkins, edición de Swagger
• BBDD tanto relacionales como no relacionales ( Mongodb , Mariadb, Oracle, Mysql, SQL Server, etc)
• Experiencia con Brokers de mensajería preferiblemente Kafka pero también se valora RabbitMQ.
• Experiencia en integraciones con servicios Cloud.
• Metodologías Agile: Scrum/Kanban.
•... Habituado a trabajar con Clean Code y principios SOLID.

Valorable:
• Valorable experiencia en programación reactiva con reactor/spring webflux/RX/Vertex.
• Nivel avanzado de inglés
• Estabilidad laboral.
• Trabajar en importantes proyectos con las tecnologías más punteras.
• Posibilidad de realizar proyectos internacionales.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Frontend Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Back to Job Board Barcelona Area R&D Full-time

Frontend Software Engineer - Design System team (Barcelone)
Contentsquare is a global digital analytics company empowering the brands you interact with every day to build better online experiences for all. Since our founding in France in 2012, we have grown to be a truly global and distributed team – known as the CSquad – representing more than 70 nationalities across the world.In 2022, we raised $600M in Series F funding and were recognised as a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Israel, US and UK. About The Role: This role can be based either in Paris , Rennes , Lyon , Tel Aviv, Barcelona or is open to remote. Are you interested in UX ? Do you care about all the details that make an online experience simple, clear and yet remarkable ?Do you want to work with cutting-edge web technologies in a multicultural and multi-disciplinary team ? If so, we are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer for our Design System Core... Team.Challenges related to Design System are many: beyond providing an exhaustive library of visual components that are easy to use, a good design system must be well documented and tested; ensure compliance with a11y and allow to display data in many different ways.As a member of this team, you will work on a day to day basis with UX designers and other Software engineers to improve the ContentSquare Design System. We're looking for an enthusiastic follower of good practice with at least 5 years' experience of front end development with a strong focus on the implementation of a library of components. We highly value user experience, the quality of the interfaces we deploy, and the quality of the code written. This is especially important for components that are used by dozens of software engineers. Being capable of designing components that are open enough for customization without allowing their usage to be diverted is key.You'd be joining a team of 50+ full-stack engineers where the average experience is 6 years in the industry, with many close to 10 years.We run regular internal sessions to share knowledge and we form tech guilds on complex subjects to figure out challenges and solutions to them. We work with some of the biggest websites and apps across the world and we're always pushing the boundaries of what's possible at this scale. With pushes to production at least once a day you'll be motivated by seeing your work go live quickly and add value to our clients.

Responsibilities::
• Develop and implement new components of the Design System
• Implement any needed tool to help Quality engineers to validate a new version of the Design System (visual regression, ...)
• Write good quality code and build out test automation (unit and functional tests).
• Write documentation for any new component
• Communication: Work closely with members feature team to ensure components of the Design System fit their needs; Act as Design System advocate; Work closely with a11y expert to ensure compliance with a11y WCAG
• Stack / Tools: Typescript, StencilJS, D3JS, WebComponent Storybook

Why join ContentSquare's Application team? :
• You'll get to work on a variety of cool projects, such as working on applications with intensive data visualizations.
• You'll work in an environment where you'll have the opportunity to work with a group of talented, ambitious people.
• You'll be exposed to the complexities of working with some of the biggest sites, apps, and brands in the world.
• You'll be joining a company that's seen incredible growth and market traction.
• You'll be joining a company that truly cares about its employees and works hard to make sure your efforts are rewarded.
• You'll be building a product that our clients truly love and they tell us this regularly (NPS 44.1 ) Why you should join our R&D department? Here is our R&D Manifesto We write our own story. We think for ourselves, keeping an open mind and engaging in constructive criticism. We are transparent in what we do and why we do it. We build and leverage tech expertise to answer business challenges. Learning from all experiences, we deliver continuous improvements in production. We empower all team members to have an end-to-end impact, take initiative, and bring new ideas to life. We stand together and thrive together; team spirit and solidarity matter even more than strong expertise. We live a human adventure. Why you should join Contentsquare: We're humans first. We hire dedicated people and provide them with the trust, resources and flexibility to get the job done. We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are a fast growing company with a track record of success over the past 10 years, yet we operate with the agility of a startup. That means a huge chance to create an immediate and lasting impact. Our clients, partners and investors love our industry-leading product. To keep our employees happy and engaged, we are always assessing the benefits/perks we offer to ensure we are competitive. Here are a few we want to highlight: Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year. Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies. Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different). Immediate eligibility for birthing and non-birthing parental leave. Wellbeing allowance. Home Office Allowance. A Culture Crew in every country to coordinate regular outings such as game nights, movie nights, and happy hours. Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company's success. We offer many benefits in various countries -- ask your recruiter for more information. We are a 2023 Circle Back Initiative Employer – we commit to responding to every applicant Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. Apply

jobs_results.title: Front End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Tenemos la misión de liderar la transformación digital de la industria de la construcción. Para ello, trabajamos desarrollando productos que optimizan procesos de negocio, mejoran la comunicación, aseguran la calidad y mejoran la sostenibilidad de todas las grandes obras civiles en las que se implantan.

Trabajamos en un ambiente internacional. Desde el Hub de desarrollo de Madrid colaborarás estrechamente con otros centros ubicados en Alemania, Estados Unidos, Hong Kong y Australia.
Te incorporarás en un equipo Scrum multidisciplinar formado por compañeros de negocio, Software Engineers, DevOps o QA, lo que te permitirá tener una visión completa de los proyectos en los que trabajes.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?
Te integrarás en un equipo que está dedicado a desarrollar una plataforma creada para dar servicio a los proyectos de construcción en áreas como: procesamiento y clasificación de nubes de puntos, reconocimiento por imagen, visualización 2D y 3D, gestión y seguimiento de las... tareas del día a día, control de costes, seguimiento de equipos humanos...

Como Front End trabajarás dentro de un equipo Scrum multidisciplinar (Front, Back y Mobile developers y QA). Con ellos asistirás a las diferentes ceremonias Scrum (en inglés) y participarás activamente en reuniones de estimación de tareas (poker estimating meeting).

Acerca del proceso de selección
Será relativamente rápido e intentaremos que no pasen más de 2 semanas entre la primera toma de contacto contigo y la entrevista final. Las fases del proceso son:

• Primera toma de contacto por teléfono con el equipo de Talent: te facilitaremos toda la información de la posición y comentaremos juntos tus experiencias profesionales.

• Entrevista con los compañeros de Management

• Entrevista final con PO

¿Suena bien?
Inscríbete y comentamos más detalles de la posición

Teletrabajo 100% desde cualquier localización en España. Si prefieres trabajar en la oficina también es opción; estamos en la zona de Prosperidad (Madrid)
• Acceso a plataformas de formación online: gracias a ellas podrás reforzar todos tus conocimientos técnicos y aprender nuevos skills en función de tus intereses.
• Clases de inglés online
• Retribución flexible: Tickets restaurant, guardería, transporte y seguro de salud.

Tecnologías:

ANGULAR, ARQ. MICROSERVICIOS, METODOLOGÍAS AGILE, REACT JS, TDD, TYPESCRIPT

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Doofinder has been helping companies of any size to access all the technologies they need to grow since 2011, always putting people at the center.

We are helping our friends from Doofinder to make their dream team grow with the incorporation of a person who takes on the challenge of Backend Developer.If you want to help companies around the world to continue to grow , you are in the right place.

WHAT IS THEIR PURPOSE?

Doofinder was born to make the technologies that companies of any size from around the world need to grow more affordable. Their team has developed since 2011 the top search engine for website and e-commerce, that helps retailers online to increase their sales.

They are agile, open, inclusive and customer-centric. But above it all, in Doofinder people come first. They are a company with people of many different nationalities, cultures and languages. They sell all over the world and speak the language of our customers. That makes theirenvironment a place where they... learn every day: they are enriched by the origin, culture, and personal history of very different people who have a common dream – to make powerful, affordable products and to contribute to the sustainable future of our thousands of customers.
WHY YOU SHOULD FALL IN LOVE WITH DOOFINDER?

Doofinder was born from the confluence of a programmer and a sales person. They set out to build a tool that would save costs to companies; a project that was initially intended as a call center automation pivoted to a search engine that democratizes access to technology to more than 5000 customers in over 50 countries, and hasmore than 80 employees. And all this without external funding at any stage of the product's life.

But what has made Doofinder number one in Europe and number two in the world in its field? It is an internal search engine that allows ecommerce users to find what they are looking for, automatically and effortlessly. The technology reaches a level of power that allows to offer a personalized result to the user from his first session, and without having registered. This is possible thanks toartificial intelligence technologies.
WHICH WILL YOUR MISSION BE?

As part of their engineering team you will join a tightly-knit group of extremely talented software engineers, who enjoy solving hard problems and work as a team to innovate.You will be part of a smart and experienced team with a broad range of skills and a really sociable and positive attitude.

You will work in Doofinder's backend team developing and maintaining backend systems with tools such asPython,Django,Ruby,ErlangorElixir, and using technologies likeAmazon Web Service (AWS)and assuming the role of software engineer with a good dose of performance engineering.
• Work within your team and with others to ensure the overall vision of the project is being fulfilled.
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL?
• Motivation to learn and work with leading technologies such as Elixir and Phoenix.
• Experience with functional languages in back-end environments such as Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Python.
• Good collaboration in a team environment.
• Ability to adapt to new environments.
• Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).

They'll fall in love with you if you have also...
• Experience developing with Elixir.
• Expertise with Phoenix framework.
• Experience working with Python and Django.
• Good English communication skills, both spoken and written.
HOW THE HIRING PROCESS WILL BE?
• Interview with the Growara team.
• Coffee with the team.Where you can meet two people from the technical team in an informal chat to discuss technical aspects and projects.
• Technical test where youcan choose between solving a technical test or showing them one of your repositories that you are proud of.
• Video call with the technical teamto comment on your tech test or your own repository and share opinions.
• Final interview with HR Manager andCTO (Cultural fit).

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU ENJOY?

???? A competitive salary band, according to the talent of each person, you will have a career plan built together with Doofinder.You will be the owner of your career within the company

???? Be part of a multicultural work environment in which you learn every day.

???? Hybrid model of work, going to the office for only 3 days.

???? Rapid growth company with a future project on ecommerce industry.

???? Flexibility to attend or organize events.

???? Team building activities, that encourage getting to know teammates within a friendly environment.(There's also pizza and barbecue to stick together ????)
HOW CAN YOU SHARE YOUR TALENT WITH US?

At Growara, we are genuinely committed to creating an inclusive work environment where each individual feels valued and respected for their talent and skills. We firmly believe that diversity is a strength that enriches our companies and communities, and we strive to ensure that everyone has equal opportunities to grow and thrive in the workplace, regardless of their gender, origin, including racial or ethnic background, marital status, social status, religion or beliefs, political ideas, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, sexual characteristics, or any other personal, family, or social condition or circumstance.

Our ethical social responsibility drives us to continue working towards a fairer and more inclusive society, where talent and merit are the sole criteria guiding our decisions in the personnel selection process.

To apply for this life-changing opportunity, all you have to do is register your application in the offer. Growara is a talent community of more than 40,000 people connected by a common passion: creating brutal careers. If you apply, you will allow us to offer you new challenges like this one.

Thank you for trusting Growara for your next professional step.

Contacto Cristina Head of Talent Acquisition
Doofinder has been helping companies of any size to access all the technologies they need to grow since 2011, always putting people at the center.

jobs_results.title: BackEnd Developers Java
jobs_results.description:
En BCNC GROUP buscamos incorporar Senior BackEnd Developers Java con experiencia contrastada en proyectos de microservicios para formar parte de nuestro equipo deslocalizado en una de las más importantes empresas multinacionales del sector retail.

Requisitos:
• Ingeniería en Informática, Sistemas o similar.
• Experiencia mínima de 4 años participando en el diseño de arquitectura de sistemas basado en servicios distribuidos.
• Experiencia demostrable en entornos de ejecución de alto rendimiento y concurrencia.
• Habituado/a a trabajar en desarrollo bajo el modelo de integración continua y revisión de código.
• Experiencia realizando labores de diseño y desarrollo de APIs, con Java (817), Spring framework, fundamentos DDD aplicando metodologías Agile: Scrum/Kanban, SOLID, Clean code, gestores de colas (kafka) y BBDD no relacionales.
• Muy valorable aportar experiencia en patrones y formas de organizar el código en pro de hacer el código más legible y mantenible.

Funciones:
• Análisis... implementación y refinamiento de tareas técnicas.
• Asegurar la calidad de los desarrollos.
• Revisión y validación de tareas de otros compañeros.
• Diagnostico y resolución de posibles incidencias.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Estabilidad laboral.
• Trabajar en importantes proyectos con las tecnologías más
punteras.
• Posibilidad de realizar proyectos internacionales.
• Desarrollo de carrera real y formación.
• Retribución flexible (guardería, restaurante, seguro médico y transporte).
• Flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva viernes, julio y agosto.
• Teletrabajo 100%.
BCNC GROUP ) es una empresa de ingeniería y tecnología con operaciones en España, UK, Alemania, Francia y Suecia. Trabajamos con las multinacionales más prestigiosas de Europa ayudándoles a implementar sus proyectos estratégicos

jobs_results.title: Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Sipay is looking for a Python Developer with experience between 1 and 3 years. Its objective will be to develop new projects in the API in addition to continuing the current projects.

In your day to day work with the most modern technologies ...Python3.6+ (We have projects in version 3.8)OpenAPI3Our APIs are GraphQL and REST, and we are experts in integrating with third party APIs.
We work with microservices philosophy.

We integrate with third-party HTTP APIs, we produce our own APIs and we integrate with non-http protocols, so we will value knowledge both in integrations with APIs and in modeling them.
When deploying, we use Jenkins, Docker and to package you will work with pypoetry.
What do we expect from you?A committed, proactive profile with a strong focus on problem solving.
Open mind and focused on continuous innovation.#J-18808-Ljbffr
